data.one_liner: A customizable library for creating alerts, loading indicators, and dialogues.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of modern, customizable alert dialogues, including standard notifications, loading indicators, image dialogues, list alerts, and fully custom bodies. It uses static methods for easy triggering and supports singleton theme management.
use_when: You need standard popup alerts, success/error dialogs, or loading indicators in your app.
You want to display list items or web-based images inside a customizable modal dialog.
You prefer an imperative API approach to show alerts via static methods.
avoid_when: You require complex state management solutions built directly into navigation dialog flows.
You need inline alert banners rather than modal popup dialogues.
strengths: Simple static API for quick integration.
Supports loading indicators, custom bodies, list alerts, and web images out of the box.
Includes singleton theme management for consistent styling.
weaknesses: Limited to dialog and popup alerts rather than flexible inline UI components.
Relies on imperative trigger calls rather than declarative state-driven UI models.
data.minimal_example:
AwesomeAlert.show(
  context,
  title: "Modern Alert",
  description: "This is using the new static API!",
  confirmText: "Cool!",
  confirmAction: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
);
